task: Fix markitdown exception handling in MarkdownCacheService to gracefully handle UnsupportedFormatException and FileConversionException with fallback strings cached to storage.

key_reasoning.reason: Diffstat reports 7 files changed (642 insertions, 5 deletions), placing this at L per the 7–10 file bracket. The two primary files — markdown_cache_service.py and test_markdown_cache_service.py — account for roughly 500 of those insertions; the remaining five files likely cover __init__ exports, wiring points, or conftest additions.

Scoped to a single service class (MarkdownCacheService). The fix adds try/except blocks around convert_file_to_markdown calls, introduces MIME-type and extension skip logic for CSV/EML/MSG files, and caches fallback strings for failed conversions — all within one file.
